__broaden__.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, down along; + gen./acc.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατ’ … ἕζετο = καθέζετο ’sat down’) · also κατ’ ἔμ’ αὐτόν ’by myself, alone’ (κατά + acc.) · also κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure, rightly’ (κατά + acc.) · also + acc., ’upon, against’ (κατ’ ἀσπίδα ’on the shield’) · also + acc., ’over’ (κατ’ ὄσσε ’over the eyes’) · also + acc., ’throughout’ (κατ’ Ἀχαιΐδα ’throughout Achaea’) · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in’ (κατ’ ἰγνύην ’in the hollow of the knee’) · also + gen., ’down over’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν ’down over the eyes’) · also with αὖθι, ’on the spot’ (κατ’ αὖθι) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατ’ οὐταμένην ὠτειλήν ’out through the wound’) · also κατ’ ἐνῶπα ’face to face’ (κατά + acc., κατ’ ἐνῶπα ἰδών ’looking face to face’) · also κατ’ ἄκρης, with a fem. gen.: ’from the top down’ · also + acc. of place: ’among’ (κατ’ αὐτούς ’among them’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατ’ ὄχθης ’down into the bank’)

__broaden__.μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστίον: ’the middle of the sail’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγκῶνα: ’the middle (of the elbow)’ (ἀγκῶνα … μέσον ’full on the elbow’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’the middle, the space between’ (ἐς μέσον ἀμφοτέρων ’into the space between the two’) · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with the man struck, ’through the middle’ (δουρὶ μέσον περόνησεν ’pierced him through the middle with a spear’) · also neut. acc. sg. as an adverb + gen.: ’midway between’ (μέσον τάφρου καὶ τείχεος ’midway between the ditch and the wall’) · also neut. acc. sg. of respect, of wasps: ’in the middle, at the waist’ (μέσον αἰόλοι ’nimble at the waist’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with στῆθος or σάκος: ’middle’ (στῆθος μέσον ’the middle of the chest’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν: ’mid-’ (μέσον οὐρανόν ’mid-heaven’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’midday’ (μέσον ἦμαρ ’mid-day’)
